I am an FY4 doctor currently working in intensive care in London. I’ll be moving to ED next year and ultimately plan on training in anaesthetics. I would also like to do more voluntary work in the future, having done some in Bulgaria last year. 

I am particularly interested in day case surgery, which I have worked to promote from both anaesthetic and surgical perspectives, and pain management, which was the subject of my PGCert. I care about anything that will improve my patients’ experiences, though, and am always involved in quality improvement. 

Outside of work I’m a huge fan of coffee, cycling (towards coffee), and high-quality sandwiches.
